summary: Frontend-only verification of the new résumé preview chip in both hero and About sections. All acceptance criteria pass: chips render/visible (opacity 1, non-zero bbox), thumbnail image loads (assets/img/resume-thumb.png, 360x465 natural size, HTTP 200 image/png, 93KB), clicking hero chip opens modal (open class + iframe with resume PDF src lazy-loaded), close button dismisses modal, and clicking About chip also opens the modal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Résumé chip enhancement verified end-to-end on both hero (data-testid hero-resume-preview-btn) and About (data-testid about-resume-preview-btn). Thumbnail at /assets/img/resume-thumb.png loads correctly; modal (data-testid resume-modal) toggles 'open' class and lazy-loads resume-iframe with src assets/resume-jacqueline-magawa.pdf#view=FitH. Close button (resume-modal-close-btn) works. No regressions observed.
